98
RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the March 13, 2003/Phalguna 22, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Prime Minister; Agro and Rural Industries; Atomic Energy;
Communications and Information Technology; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Development of North Eastern Region;
Disinvestment; External Affairs; Labour; Planning; Road
Transport and Highways; Small Scale Industries; Space;
Statistics and Progra mme Implementation)
Total number of questions—20
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Expansion of telecom network in
Andhra Pradesh
*321. SHRI K. KALAVENKATA
RAO:
SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any proposal for providing WLL system
to facilitate expansion of telecom network
in various regions of Andhra Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when WLL system would be
made available to the consumers in the
said regions?
Telephone facilities in Rajasthan
villages
†*322. DR. ABRAR AHMED: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether telephone facilities have
since been provided in all the villages of
Rajasthan;
(b) if not, the number of villages in
each district of the State which have not
been provided with telephone facilities;
(c) whether Government have set any
time-frame for providing telephone
facilities in each village of the State;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Disinvestment of EIL, STC and MUL
*323. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of
DISINVESTMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that
Government are thinking of disinvesting
the Engineers India Ltd., State Trading
Corporation and the Maruti Udyog Ltd.
by the end of this year;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any process has been
started in this regard; and
(d) if so, th e details thereof?

Food security project
*324. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Canadian International Development
Agency (CIDA) is providing C $ 5 million
(Rs. 15.5 crore) assistance to implement
a food security project in India; and
(b) the details thereof?
Telephone Lok Adalats
*325. SHRI VIJAY SINGH YADAV:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS  AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the Telephone Lok
Adalats held in Bihar during the last three
years to mitigate the public grievances in
the State, year-wise;
(b) the number of complaints disposed
of during each year;
(c) the number of complaints pending
before the Lok Adalats in the State; and
(d) whether it is proposed to hold more
sittings of Lok Adalats in order to dispose
of pending cases at the earliest?
Boundary dispute with Myanmar
*326. SHRI RISHANG KEISHING:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether any boundary dispute
exists between Myanmar and India;
(b) if so, what efforts have been made
to settle the dispute in a friendly and
peaceful way; and
(c) the steps taken to further improve
and strengthen the friendly relation
between the two countries?
Widening of NHs in Uttar Pradesh
*327. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the sections of the National
Highways in Uttar Pradesh where work
for widening is presently going on;
(b) by when the work on these sections
is likely to be completed, section-wise;
and
(c) the sections of the National
Highways in the State where similar work
is proposed to be taken up next?
Software exports
*328. DR. AKHILESH DAS: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether with the slowdown in
growth of software exports, over 55,000
fresh engineers from the Government
recognised colleges are yet to get jobs;
(b) whether a large number of
Information Technology graduates and
post-graduates had emigrated and
returned to India after September
11, 2001, if so, the estimated number
thereof;
(c) the latest assessment of the
unemployed Information Technology
engineers, graduates and post-graduates,
and other Information Technology
workers in the country; and
(d) what steps are being taken to
provide them with employment and open
up fresh avenues for Information
Technology Engineers, graduates and
post-graduates, including those
emigrating from abroad?

Extradition treaty with France
*329. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have signed
an extradition treaty with France recently;
if so, the details thereof; and
(b) the names of countries with which
extradition treaty is proposed to be signed
during the current year?
Amendment of Indian Post Office
Act, 1898
*330. SHR

RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the March 13, 2003/Phalguna 22, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Prime Minister; Agro and Rural Industries; Atomic Energy;
Communications and Information Technology; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Development of North Eastern Region;
Disinvestment; External Affairs; Labour; Planning; Road
Transport and Highways; Small Scale Industries; Space;
Statistics and Programme Implementation)
Total number of questions—155
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Programme for rural employment
†2317. SHRI MOOLCHAND
MEENA:
SHRIMATI SAROJ DUBEY:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
implementing programme for creating rural
employment;
(b) if so, the State where this
programme has been introduced during
the Ninth Five Year Plan period;
(c) the achievements under this
programme during the said period
alongwith the amount spent, State-wise;
and
(d) the assessment made during the
Tenth Five Year Plan period, State-wise?
Uranium deposits
2318. SHRI K. KALAVENKATA
RAO:
SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the coastal belt from
Srikakulam to Visakhapatnam has vast
Uranium deposits; and
(b) if so, the action taken to extract
Uranium for atomic research purposes?
Construction of nuclear reactors
2319. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) the existing number of nuclear
reactors that are under construction at
present;
(b) the target date set for completion
thereof; and
(c) the estimated cost of each of the
projects?
Plutonium-based fast breeder reactor
2320. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR
REDDY: Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to instal country's first plutonium-based
commercial fast breeder reactor in the
Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research
Complex at Kalpakkam near Chennai;

510
WIN2\SESSION\8088RS1 .pm5 510
(b) if so, the details and purpose thereof;
and
(c) whether installation of the breeder
reactor is likely to assist generation of
additional energy resources and if so, the
details thereof?
Post offices in U.P.
†2321. PROF. R.B.S. VARMA: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) the existing number of post offices
in Uttar Pradesh and post offices which are
being operated from rented houses; and
(b) the existing number of villages in
the State where post offices may be set up
as per rule and by when post offices would
be set up in all such villages?
Monthly rental of Thapakhera
exchange
†2322. SHRI RAMA SHANKER
KAUSHIK: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND INFOR-
MATION TECHNOLOGY be pleased to
state:
(a) the monthly rental for Ambedkar
Gram Thapakhera rural telephone
exchange having the capacity of 1,000 to
3,000 lines;
(b) the basis for declaring the monthly
rental of the exchange having the capacity
of 1000 to 29,999 lines as Rs. 120 though
in the Directory, it is Rs. 100;
(c) the basis for charging a monthly
rental of Rs. 250 on Exchange system
having the capacity of 100000 and more
lines, though its monthly rent has been
given Rs. 210 in the Directory; and
(d) whether the existing charge is based
on the rural and urban classification and
exchange capacity and if not, on what basis
the monthly rental of Rs. 120/- has been
fixed?
Telephone facilities in Manipur
2323. SHRI RISHANG KEISHING:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) the number of telephone subscribers
as on date in Manipur;
(b) the telephone subscribers in waiting
list;
(c) the action taken to clear the wait-
listed applicants; and
(d) the plan to expand telephone service
in the rural and hilly districts?
Internet charges
2324. DR. C. NARAYANA REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that internet
browsing charges are likely to increase due
to rise in telephone tariff;
(b) whether Government propose to
moderate the charges; and
(c) what are the measures contemplated
in this regard?
Spurt in software piracy
2325. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND INFOR-
MATION TECHNOLOGY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the software piracy rate,

recorded a spurt to 70 per cent  during
2001 and whether the estimates for 2002
is pegged at 73 per cent;
(b) whether 7 out of every 10 software
packages sold in the country are pirated;
(c) whether the high-profit margin in
pirated software packages is attracting
investments by the underworld in the trade;
and
(d) if so, the steps being taken to check
the piracy?
Rural Postal Life Insurance
2326. SHRI AIMADUDDIN AHMED
KHAN (DURRU)
